evidence: Verg. A. 8.618: oculōs per singula volvit
terms.comment: The neuter plural of singulī, one by one: per singula, in detail; rem per singula inīre, go into a matter in detail (Traupman 302).

evidence: Cic. Verr. 2.5.143: singillātim potius quam generātim (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Also singulātim, and in many manuscripts sigillātim (Lewis & Short).

phrases.latin: explērī nequit atque oculōs per singula volvit
phrases.english: he cannot look his fill, and runs his eyes over every detail

phrases.latin: Rem enim tōtam per cēnam per singula inībō.
phrases.english: I’ll go into the whole matter in detail over dinner.
to go into a matter in detail

sources: Lewis & Short: singuli · Lewis & Short: singillatim
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. detail: in detail.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 91, 302, checked against the searchable text of the book (9 November 2026).: p. 303.
